# Tab bar: `jl-tab-bar`

The bar along the bottom of a phone: the main places of an app, one tap away.

- Class `JlTabBar`, a organism: `import { JlTabBar } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/tab-bar

On a phone, the main places of an app belong under the thumb, not behind a menu at the top. A tab bar
holds three to five of them, an icon over a short label; keep the rest in the side navigation, and give the bar a
more button that opens it.

Items with an href are real links, so the browser's history and a long press work as people expect; items without
one are buttons. Both fire select and become the value; set value yourself when the page changes some other way.
The current item is drawn in the accent, on a pill, so it does not rely on colour alone. A badge counts what waits
there: numbers above 99 show as 99+.

In a jl-app-shell, put it in slot="tabs": the shell shows it only when narrow, keeps it under its drawer, and
opens the drawer on more.

## Use

```ts
import { JlTabBar } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlTabBar
  items={[{"href":"#home","icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":3,"href":"#inbox","icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"},{"href":"#search","icon":"search","id":"search","label":"Search"},{"href":"#account","icon":"user","id":"account","label":"Account"}]}
  more="More"
  value="home"
/>
```

```html
<jl-tab-bar
  items='[{"href":"#home","icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":3,"href":"#inbox","icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"},{"href":"#search","icon":"search","id":"search","label":"Search"},{"href":"#account","icon":"user","id":"account","label":"Account"}]'
  more="More"
  value="home"
></jl-tab-bar>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `items` (attribute `items`): `TabBarItem<Id>[]`, default `[]`. The places: id, label, icon, and an optional href and badge.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `Id | ''`, default `''`. The id of the current item.
- `more` (attribute `more`): `string`, default `''`. The label of a last button for the other places, which fires more; empty shows none.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The name of the navigation for screen readers. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `select` (`onSelect` in JSX), detail `Id`: An item was pressed: its id. It is now the value.
- `more` (`onMore` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The more button was pressed.

## Styling

- `--height` (custom property): The least height of the bar, above the safe area (60px).
- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The bar.

## Typing

Typed by its ids, JlTabBar<'home' | 'jobs' | 'inbox'> takes items of those ids only, and gives select and value as one of them: the editor completes them and refuses another.

```ts
import type { JlTabBar } from '@syware/jlib';

type Place = 'home' | 'jobs' | 'inbox';

const tabs = document.querySelector<JlTabBar<Place>>('jl-tab-bar');
tabs?.items.set([
  { icon: 'house', id: 'home', label: 'Home' },
  { icon: 'briefcase', id: 'jobs', label: 'Jobs' },
  { badge: 3, icon: 'inbox', id: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox' },
]);
// @ts-expect-error: 'settings' is not a place of the tab bar
tabs?.value.set('settings');
tabs?.events.register('select', (place) => goTo(place)); // place: Place
```

```tsx
import { Jadis } from '@jadis/core';
import { JlTabBar } from '@syware/jlib';

import type { TabBarItem } from '@syware/jlib';

type Place = 'home' | 'jobs' | 'inbox';

const PLACES: TabBarItem<Place>[] = [
  { icon: 'house', id: 'home', label: 'Home' },
  { icon: 'briefcase', id: 'jobs', label: 'Jobs' },
  { badge: 3, icon: 'inbox', id: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox' },
];

export class AppTabs extends Jadis {
  static readonly selector = 'app-tabs';

  templateHtml(): Node {
    // value="settings" does not compile.
    return <JlTabBar<Place> items={PLACES} value="home" more="More" onSelect={(place) => goTo(place)} />;
  }
}

AppTabs.register();
```

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Main places

Links with icons and a count; the current one is drawn in the accent.

```html
<div style="max-width: 390px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); overflow: hidden">
  <jl-tab-bar value="inbox" items='[{"href":"#home","icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":3,"href":"#inbox","icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"},{"href":"#search","icon":"search","id":"search","label":"Search"},{"href":"#account","icon":"user","id":"account","label":"Account"}]'></jl-tab-bar>
</div>
```

### With more

The other places behind a last button: in an app shell, it opens the drawer.

```html
<div class="stack" style="max-width: 390px">
  <div style="max-width: 390px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); overflow: hidden; max-width: none">
    <jl-tab-bar class="demo-more" value="home" more="More" items='[{"href":"#home","icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":128,"href":"#orders","icon":"package","id":"orders","label":"Orders"},{"badge":"New","href":"#reports","icon":"chart","id":"reports","label":"Reports"}]'></jl-tab-bar>
  </div>
  <span class="muted demo-said">Press More.</span>
</div>
```

```js
root.querySelector('.demo-more').events.register('more', () => {
  root.querySelector('.demo-said').textContent = 'more fired: open the navigation.';
});
```

### Buttons

Without href, the items are buttons: select says which one, for views switched in place.

```html
<div class="stack" style="max-width: 390px">
  <div style="max-width: 390px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); overflow: hidden; max-width: none">
    <jl-tab-bar class="demo-select" value="list" label="Views" items='[{"icon":"list","id":"list","label":"List"},{"icon":"layout-grid","id":"grid","label":"Grid"},{"icon":"calendar","id":"calendar","label":"Calendar"}]'></jl-tab-bar>
  </div>
  <span class="muted demo-view">Showing the list.</span>
</div>
```

```js
root.querySelector('.demo-select').events.register('select', (id) => {
  root.querySelector('.demo-view').textContent = `Showing the ${id}.`;
});
```
